entries.raw: Detailed Performance Distribution: The experimental results demonstrate consistent performance scaling across diverse graph configurations. Small graphs (100 nodes) achieved minimal speedup (1.00× to 1.07×) due to insufficient computational density to overcome parallelization overhead. Medium graphs (500-1000 nodes) showed substantial improvements (1.29× to 2.89×) with optimal thread utilization emerging at 6-8 threads.
